classification: RETROSPECTIVE_RESEARCH / UNTRUSTED_SHADOW / PIT_NOT_ADMITTED / predictive skill NOT_ESTABLISHED
non_claims: A candidate station measurement is not a stadium condition and a rank-one station is not an accepted station.
The provider scheduled start is the association clock, not the actual kickoff or an official schedule.
Current catalog venues, coordinates and dome flags are reference observations, not historical effective venue or roof facts.
Observed 2024 weather is retrospective evidence, never a forecast input or a 2023 forecast substitute.
No PIT admission, model fit, training, protected evaluation, activation or predictive skill is established.
The 920-row pilot is not the national denominator; the 882 promoted relations and the 882 observations within 30 minutes are different sets.
Precipitation AA groups stay raw text; no hourly total is invented and no acceptance threshold exists.

grains.contests: one record per accepted 2024 parent contest (contest_key = ncaa:<id>, or the parent's nolink:2024:<date>:org:<a>|org:<b> key of a contest without an NCAA contest ID)
grains.pilots: one record per original pilot row (pilot_key = the SRC-002 source_game_id)

ordering.pilots: original kickoff_at_utc, source_game_id (the original pilot's order; original_row_index)
ordering.witnesses: inputs in contract order, parent contracts in contract order, raw files in station-year order, then selected raw rows by station-year order and CSV row number

layout.serialization: canonical JSON lines (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', UTF-8, no ASCII escaping); one zlib level-9 block per table segment in the database; no separate payload files

segments.witnesses: SOURCE for inputs, contracts and raw files; the station-year calendar year for selected rows

ddl: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE blocks (ord INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, record_table TEXT NOT NULL, segment TEXT NOT NULL, records INTEGER NOT NULL, first_key TEXT, last_key TEXT, lines_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, block BLOB NOT NULL)

identity_documents.identity: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of the document; compared as canonical bytes, never by Python equality (13.0, booleans and extra members differ)
identity_documents.location: <root>/canonical/national_observed_weather_evidence_2024/sha256/<database identity>/national_observed_weather_evidence.sqlite; manifest at <root>/manifests/national_observed_weather_evidence_2024/sha256/<database identity>/run_manifest.json with members identity, identity_document, content_identity, content_document and provenance; create-only (identical rebuild ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL, differing bytes REFUSED_IMMUTABLE_COLLISION)

layout.checkpoint_unit: one station-year capture: its station-year record, the selections of every pilot row it serves and their selected raw-row witnesses; contests, the other witnesses and the census follow

selectors.season: an integer football season; the release covers 2024 only (calendar 2024 and the 11 January 2025 games); any other season serves no row with SEASON_OUTSIDE_RELEASE
selectors.contest: an exact parent contest key ncaa:<1-12 digits> or nolink:2024:<YYYY-MM-DD>:org:<digits>|org:<digits> (bare digits are refused: an NCAA number never equals a provider number); contest grain: contest_key; pilot grain: the promoted contest_key only (never the unpromoted candidate)
selectors.provider_game: an exact SRC-002 provider game ID (1-12 digits); contest grain: the promoted provider_game_id only; pilot grain: provider_game_id
selectors.station: an exact NOAA ISD station identity NNNNNN-NNNNN (USAF-WBAN); contest grain: the associated station; pilot grain: the original station_id; station-year: station_id; witness: the selected row's or raw file's station (inputs and contracts carry none)
selectors.paging: --limit (default 50, non-negative), --offset (non-negative) or --all; exact totals in record order
selectors.intersection: selectors intersect; an unknown or disjoint valid selection serves no row; malformed or inapplicable selectors are refused before any file is read
selectors.pit: --require-pit is always refused; no historical as-of selector is offered

refusals.stderr: one JSON object with members refused (the code) and error (the text); nothing on stdout

scope.population: all 1,672 accepted 2024 parent contests (FBS/FCS and recorded outside-division opponents), all 920 retained observed-weather pilot rows and all 157 retained NOAA ISD station-year captures (11 football-season-2024 games dated in calendar 2025 included)
scope.horizon: retrospective research on observed station records; no forecast vintage, PIT admission, actual kickoff, actual stadium condition, historical effective venue or roof state, model use or predictive skill
scope.not_audited: other seasons, alternate or non-rank-one stations, forecast weather, travel/rest/time-zone context and every other domain (BAT-417/BAT-419 remain open)
